cohort: Pregnant women requiring delivery with a malpresenting fetus at a preterm gestational age
finding: External cephalic version (ECV) was successful in 50% of preterm breech presentations, with no significant complications or fetal mortality, suggesting it may be a viable alternative to Cesarean delivery in this population.
mod_finding: The study suggests external cephalic version (ECV) at preterm gestational ages may be an appropriate alternative to Cesarean delivery for malpresenting fetuses.
